Admin Role Resource Delete Role
DELETE
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/adminRoles/:roleId

Deletes the admin role based on the specified ID.

Note: This endpoint is accessible via Zscaler OneAPI only.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
roleId
int32
REQUIRED

Specifies the role ID

Responses
​
204
401
403
404
500

No Content
